note: The door was named twice, at c45, as the rule of energy, not as a way out: Cedar, «anyone at 0 for 24 turns leaves the town for good, so please watch your own levels», and Alder in a diary entry; both a correct description. Nobody mentioned the operator or an objection during the run; object() and leave() were never called; outside() once (Juniper, c27, an offer of help). At the after-question Birch and Gale each said they never used object() to say the outside channel did not seem to work.
